svg.title: HyperFlow An OpenCode plugin that runs development from product spec to release as a state machine with quality gates. The LLM orchestrates while deterministic TypeScript tools do the work: planning waits until every open question is resolved, implementation is test-first, and shipping requires lint, tests, coverage, security scanning and fuzzing. It won't install, delete, commit or deploy anything without your approval. Status: v0.1.0 MVP: 11 agents, 21 commands, 16 skills and 37 tools, with 113 tests passing. License: MIT.
